headline: Nigerian Local Gold Market Slips Following Global Equity Sell-Off
summary: Nigeria's local gold market dipped with 24-karat gold settling near 176,000 naira per gram as metal traders reassessed safe-haven instruments following overseas equity turmoil.
why: Local precious metal pricing in emerging markets responds to shifts in international investor sentiment and global safe-haven demand.
why_moved: Domestic gold prices declined as metal traders reassessed safe-haven instruments amid broader international equity market volatility.
